# Fulfilment Format

## Summary
One money formatter and one timestamp formatter for the whole fulfilment family, so a board aggregate that is a plain number and an `AmountWithCurrency` atom on a card never print the same fact two ways.

## API
- `money(amount, code = 'GBP')` — `Intl.NumberFormat` currency style; `—` for an absent amount; falls back to the raw number if the code is unknown
- `stamp(value)` — medium date + short time; `—` for an absent value. Day and minute both matter: "did it land inside the promised window" is a question about the time.

## Usage
```ts
import { money, stamp } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/fulfilment/fulfilment-format';

money(stock.totalValue); // £34.39
stamp(shipment.deliveredAt); // 5 Aug 2026, 11:20
```
Used by Order, Shipment, Product, Vendor and the line-item field; consumers extending those cards should format through it too.

## Non-goals
No arithmetic and no currency conversion — it renders a number it is given. Money values on cards stay in the base `AmountWithCurrency` field; this only formats them.
